name: @wedding-planner/product
description: The customer-facing product surface: the white-label, multi-tenant web app real wedding planners and their couples sign up for, theme, and use. Built offline-first, launch-ready (onboarding/billing/comms simulated; going live is human-reserved). Phase 12 lays the multi-tenant domain core and the tenant-isolation boundary; HTTP/UI/onboarding land in later phases. Specs live alongside the code.
